title: Give the four run-wait delivery tests an explicit scripted Engram budget clock before their first admission snapshot
outcome: The four delivery tests added with the run-wait classifier fix (src/tests/test_run_waits/run_wait_evidence.rs around :172, built on settled_delivery_fixture) reach start_next_queued_turn_inner_off_lock through completion, idle registration and Resume. That function unconditionally snapshots self.engram_budget_clock(), so the default Real clock is read even though Engram is disabled for these sessions. This misses slice 1's explicit clock choice and leaves the fixture unable to choose a clock afterwards. Wanted: settled_delivery_fixture selects the state's scripted clock (select_test_scripted_engram_budget_clock) before registration or completion. These are positive delivery witnesses, not real-time expiry tests. No assertion changes.
acceptance: Give the four run-wait delivery tests an explicit scripted Engram budget clock before their first admission snapshot is done
